name: app.naulon/naulon
title: naulon
description: Check citations and retractions by DOI, and see the x402 price an AI agent pays to cite a source.

environmentVariables.name: PAYMENT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to gateway to pay real tolls in USDC over Circle Gateway on Arc. Unset, settlement is mocked and nothing is spent.

environmentVariables.name: BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of the wallet tolls are paid from. Needed only with PAYMENT_MODE=gateway. It stays on your machine.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLGATE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The one gate every payment resolves against, for buying from a single publisher.

environmentVariables.name: WAYFARER_ALLOW_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated publisher hosts the server may pay. Replaces the single-gate pin, so one server can buy from several publishers.

environmentVariables.name: WAYFARER_BUDGET_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Spend ceiling for the session, in USDC. The model cannot raise it.
